headline: Studds Accessories offers securities purchase options to eligible employees

summary: Studds Accessories Limited has informed the stock exchange about offering options to purchase securities to its identified eligible employees. summary: Studds Accessories Limited has announced the commencement of commercial production at its Manufacturing Facility V.
